name: Ore no Nee-chan. ~Ore wa Nee-chan no Omocha ja Nai!~
original_name: オレの姉ちゃん。～オレは姉ちゃんのオモチャじゃないっ！～
source:
Haruki has three older sisters. He lives peacefully with them, but his life suddenly changes after he receives a love letter from his lifelong friend. Yes, they start approaching him in various ways!? Haruki is about to lose his reason!!!

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
春树有三个姐姐。他和他们过着平静的生活，但当他收到一生挚友的一封情书后，他的生活突然发生了变化。是的，他们开始以各种方式接近他！？春树快要失去理智了！！！

[来自工口游戏商店]
